baseline_models.mechanism: The passive refusal blocks the normal exchange by which a captive is released: custody cannot be transferred onto a substitute.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the custody from which ransom would ordinarily release a person; negation makes that release unavailable.
Captive exchange supplies the substitution mechanism that the clause explicitly refuses.

changed_reading.after: No substitute can sever the addressees from the custody now claimed over them.

baseline_models.mechanism: Fire is named both the place that gathers them and the nearest relation that governs or has the strongest claim upon them; refuge is inverted into hostile custody.

activation_trace.role: Joining a place that gathers and shelters supplies the enclosing function of مأوى.
Blazing fire supplies the hostile substance of that abode.
Unseparated nearness makes fire an inescapably adjacent relation, not a remote destination.
Taking charge supplies the governing force latent in مولاكم.
Priority or entitlement lets مولاكم carry the sense of the claimant most fitting or entitled to them.

changed_reading.before: They go to fire, which is called their master or ally.
changed_reading.after: Fire is their enclosing abode and closest governing claimant, a refuge relation turned against its occupants.

baseline_models.mechanism: The severe event named by اليوم is the threshold at which an ongoing becoming resolves into a fixed dwelling and explicit condemnation.

activation_trace.role: A momentous occurrence gives اليوم the force of an arrived crisis, not merely a calendar date.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the trajectory that now reaches its end.
A settled place turns the outcome into a terminal abode.
The explicit formula of blame seals the valuation of that resolved destination.

changed_reading.before: A bad end is announced for the future.
changed_reading.after: Today is the closure point at which a trajectory becomes an occupied, condemned destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, what is taken is the addressees' binding covenant; at judgment, what is not taken is their ransom. The accepted bond precedes and resists the attempted substitute.

activation_trace.role: Earlier taking holds a concrete object, the covenant, as an already-established claim.
The confirmed covenant makes that earlier object a binding bond rather than a payment.
The same taking verb now appears passively under negation, changing the admissible object.
A thing offered in place of a person supplies the rejected attempt to commute the bond.

structural_cues: 57:8 precedes judgment with قد أخذ ميثاقكم; 57:15 repeats أخذ but rejects فدية as its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated أخذ and an explicit binding covenant; I infer that the prior bond is the claim a later substitute cannot commute. A live alternative is simple verbal contrast without legal causation.

changed_reading.after: The covenant has already been taken as the governing bond, so a later substitute cannot buy out its accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the day, wealth can go out as spending or be cut off as a good loan and return multiplied; on the day, value offered as a self-substitute is refused. The issue is timely relinquishment versus late self-purchase, not the worthlessness of giving.

activation_trace.role: Money going out in expenditure supplies voluntary relinquishment before judgment.
Cutting off wealth or work so its recompense returns supplies the accepted pre-judgment transaction.
Increase by a matching amount makes the timely loan productive rather than merely lost.
Substitution for the threatened person supplies the late transaction that is denied.
The arrived crisis marks the boundary after which value can no longer be converted into escape.

structural_cues: 57:7 promises a great reward for spending, 57:11 offers multiplication for a good loan, and 57:18 repeats the loan-and-multiplication sequence after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accepted spending and multiplied lending on both sides of the refused ransom; I infer a temporal asymmetry between prior surrender and crisis-time buyout. These could instead be separate devotional and judicial economies.

changed_reading.after: Wealth is efficacious when relinquished beforehand as entrusted value, but cannot be retained until crisis and tendered as a substitute for the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The excluded group asks to take light from another source, is sent back to seek it, and meets an enclosing wall; the next verdict names fire from the same mapped root inventory as their abode and nearest relation. Nontransferable guiding light is answered by enclosing fire.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the beneficial light they lack, request, and are told to seek.
Taking a flame from its source makes the request for borrowed light materially adjacent to fire.
A high enclosing wall makes light and mercy nontransferable across a fixed boundary.
Blazing fire supplies the punitive counterpart to the light sought just before.
The abode gathers the excluded group on the punitive side of the boundary.
Immediate proximity turns fire into the relation left nearest after separation from the illuminated group.

structural_cues: 57:12 gives believers forward-moving light; 57:13 places mercy inside the wall and punishment outside; 57:15 follows the failed companionship claim of 57:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared ن و ر inventory, the flame-taking image in اقتباس, and the wall sequence; I infer that failed light acquisition is narratively converted into fire affiliation. Fire may instead be only the next punishment clause, without deliberate lexical inversion.

changed_reading.before: Fire is a hostile home after light has been lost.
changed_reading.after: Once guiding light cannot be borrowed across the wall, the only remaining ن و ر relation is fire: an anti-light that encloses and governs instead of guiding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-interested waiting and glittering deception continue until the command arrives; the following warning describes a prolonged term reaching its limit. اليوم therefore closes accumulated delay into irreversible destination.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and watching supplies the deliberate postponement that consumes the open interval.
A glittering but unstable deception explains why postponement feels viable until it collapses.
Lengthened time supplies the extended interval in which responsiveness deteriorates.
A term's endpoint supplies the limit that delay eventually reaches.
The severe arrived event converts the exhausted interval into present foreclosure.
Becoming toward an outcome makes the deadline the culmination of a process, not an arbitrary cutoff.

structural_cues: 57:14 says حتى جاء أمر الله; 57:16 immediately asks whether the time has arrived and warns that prolonged duration hardens hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies waiting, deception, arrival of the command, and a lengthened term; I infer a causal arrow from deferred response to foreclosure. اليوم could alternatively label resurrection without emphasizing accumulated delay.

changed_reading.before: Today is simply the date when ransom is refused.
changed_reading.after: Today is delay's exhausted limit: a long, deceptively open interval has hardened into an outcome that no late substitute can reopen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later warning uses the same root for actively turning away that the focus uses for fire as مولاكم. Chosen disengagement does not produce neutrality; it recoils as enforced proximity and governance by another relation.

activation_trace.role: Active withdrawal and refusal of approach supply the chosen relational movement.
Unbroken nearness supplies the imposed relation that answers withdrawal.
Taking charge supplies the authority fire bears in that involuntary affiliation.

structural_cues: 57:24 states ومن يتول فإن الله هو الغني الحميد, so turning away cannot diminish the relation abandoned or establish independence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root reversal between يتول and مولاكم; I infer that voluntary withdrawal is answered by involuntary affiliation. The two occurrences may instead be independent uses of a highly polysemous root.

changed_reading.before: Fire is called their ally or master.
changed_reading.after: مولاكم is the relational recoil of تولي: turning away leaves them not autonomous but inseparably adjacent to a hostile governor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from denial to the separate expiation branch within ك ف ر; it remains anchored because the focus places فدية beside الذين كفروا and the packet supplies both covering branches. Render only as a lexical chiasm, not as derivational equivalence or a legal claim.

activation_trace.role: Substitution supplies the attempted protective exchange.
Covering or denying truth supplies the group's stated identity.
Covering an offense until it is effaced supplies the unavailable counter-cover that ransom might be imagined to purchase.

changed_reading.after: Those characterized by covering truth cannot now buy a second covering that effaces the consequence of the first.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the flame branch of اقتباس and the packet's shared ن و ر mapping as a grim fulfillment of a light request; adjacency and exact branch links keep it anchored. Downstream prose should say the sequence suggests this reversal, never that نور and نار are simply identical.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نقتبس من نوركم ... فالتمسوا نورا ... النار هي مولاكم

activation_trace.role: A flame taken from its source makes the requested borrowing capable of a literal fire-image.
Beneficial illumination is the object explicitly requested and sought.
Blazing fire supplies the catastrophic object that replaces shareable guidance.
Inseparable nearness makes that replacement permanently theirs rather than briefly borrowed.

changed_reading.before: They ask for light and later receive unrelated fire.
changed_reading.after: Their request for a borrowed flame is grimly answered by fire that cannot be borrowed or returned because it has become their nearest abiding relation.

strongest_changes: The covenant is taken earlier while ransom is refused later: accountability precedes attempted substitution.
Accepted spending and multiplied lending before the day contrast with rejected self-buyout on the day.
The light request, enclosing wall, and shared ن و ر inventory turn fire into an anti-light that encloses rather than guides.
Waiting reaches its limit, while the root movement from تولي to مولاكم turns chosen withdrawal into imposed affiliation.
summary.what_was_special: Two root reversals were unusually productive: ن و ر joins sought light to punitive fire, and و ل ي joins chosen turning away to enforced proximity; the loan/ransom contrast separately exposes a temporal economy of prior relinquishment versus late substitution.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the shared ن و ر mapping should bear narrative-semantic pressure or remain only a lexicographic bridge.
How strongly مولاكم prioritizes proximity, governance, entitlement, or ironic alliance.
Whether the covenant and finance juxtapositions imply causal foreclosure or only rhetorical contrast.
